description: Declarative definition of the Supabase (Postgres) tables the Benefactor outreach system writes to. This JSON is the single source of truth: schema/schema.sql, JSON Schemas, Dart and Rust adapters, and the Supabase declarative schema are all generated from it.
migrationSafety: Generated SQL is for review. Apply via the Supabase declarative workflow (supabase db diff) or reviewed migrations. Never apply automatically.

tables.name: benefactor_outreach_clicks
tables.description: Click events from Benefactor outreach /team tracking links. Each first-touch email's link carries a per-lead signed token (HS256 JWT); the backend (/r/team) or the Cloudflare Worker (go.benefactor.cc) verifies it and inserts a row here with the service-role key. Lead-attributed: only recipients we emailed produce rows.

columns.name: lead_id
columns.description: The benefactor lead this click is attributed to (from the signed token), if a valid UUID was present.

columns.name: email
columns.description: Email of the lead that clicked (carried in the signed token).

columns.name: campaign
columns.description: Campaign key the outreach belonged to.

columns.name: ip_address
columns.description: Best-effort client IP (first X-Forwarded-For hop / CF-Connecting-IP). Not trusted.

columns.name: clicked_at
columns.description: When the click was recorded (server time).
